summary: The sidebar is composed as chrome, one scrolling body, and a footer. Setup starts on home; range fields name the next bound. The projection supplies slots and copy; the renderer pins controls and draws the timeline.

.tabthrough-guide.json.rationale: The sidecar this walk is written into

work-docs/specs/design-system.md.rationale: The visual spec this implementation follows

test/unit/setup.test.ts.rationale: Back from working-tree generate returns to home

test/unit/sidebar.test.ts.rationale: Assertions follow the new slots and copy

test/unit/sidebar-html.test.ts.rationale: Markup checks for chrome fields and choice rows

steps.title: Home is the start screen
steps.rationale: Review and Back no longer land on a separate targets page

steps.title: Range phase names the next bound
steps.rationale: Focus arms a field; the next history click writes that end
steps.notes: pick stays on the phase so the heading can say choose start or end. Click order still fills the empty end when a field is not armed.

steps.title: selectCommit carries bound payloads
steps.rationale: First consumer of focus and from:/to: without new commands

steps.title: Rows declare slot and bound
steps.rationale: The renderer parks nav, fields, and footer from these fields
steps.notes: slot is nav, header, or footer. trailing is the home chevron. input.bound prefixes typed refs so selectCommit can tell Start from End.

steps.title: Reading: notes, why, then Open file
steps.rationale: The thought is prose first; End walkthrough lives in the footer

steps.title: Home is three list choices
steps.rationale: The target rows are the actions; repository counts stay collapsed

steps.title: Range fields sit above the list
steps.rationale: Start and End are header slots; Use range is the footer commitment

steps.title: Commits draw a gutter and bound words
steps.rationale: The first consumer of accent and input.bound

steps.title: One chrome, one body, one footer
steps.rationale: Fields pin in the header; only the body scrolls
steps.notes: Home keeps its title in the body. Range fields join Back and the title so the divider sits under the inputs.
